title: Outstanding Oven Roasted Kenyan Comte Pasta
description: This dish features comte cheese, al-dente pasta, and a blend of Kenyan spices, making for a floral and springy meal that is low in glycemic index and perfect for a light dinner.

ingredients.name: kenyan spices
ingredients.notes: blend of turmeric, cumin, and coriander

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until it is al-dente.
In a large bowl, toss the cooked pasta with olive oil, garlic, kenyan spices, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, mix the shredded comte cheese with chopped spring onions and parsley.

In a baking dish, create a layer of the pasta mixture, followed by a layer of the comte cheese mixture, and repeat this process until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of comte cheese on top.
Bake the dish in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the outstanding oven roasted Kenyan comte pasta hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
